matrix: Per task and seed: one shared ESM baseline, M0/M3 on each of two Qwen backbones

gpu_policy.existing_jobs: preserve; sharing allowed when actual free memory suffices

row.sample_id: unique original or stable official-row ID
row.sequence: full uppercase source sequence, U retained
row.condition_values: list length10 of safe strings or null; no labels, IDs, split or accessions
row.target: finite original float for regression, null for elm
row.positive_ids: known positive candidate IDs for elm, [] otherwise
row.group_id: evaluation-only grouping, never a model input

data_API.catalog: list of {candidate_id,description}, fixed original31 candidates, no regex/class IDs as features
data_API.rt: train4952; selection525 for checkpoint; calibration530 only after selection; test1063. Preserve original validation1055 as audit union.
data_API.meltome: original human7287/861/1945; preserve official duplicate rows and U
data_API.elm: original378/134/76; preserve31 candidates and original class-holdout restriction

feature_API.semantics: ESM2-150M block15 hook and final normalized layer30; full ordered1022-residue chunks then float32 adaptive-average8; no cross-chunk attention
feature_API.cache: per sequence NPZ plus SHA/coverage JSON; only frozen ESM, no train-fitted parameters
feature_API.ELM_descriptions: cache/description_vectors.npz: candidate_ids unicode[31], vectors float32[31,1536]; frozen Qwen2.5-1.5B mean descriptor token states, same fixed descriptors for every arm and backbone

classes: SingleMemoryLM(base_lm, task, variant='M3', hidden_dim=1536, esm_dim=640, memory_dim=128, num_heads=4, hook_layer=13, candidate_vectors=None)
model_API.memory_inputs: exactly p15,p30 [B,8,640], condition_ids int64[B,10], observed bool[B,10]
model_API.LM_forward: forward(input_ids, attention_mask, prompt_end_index, memory_inputs, labels=None, off=False)->dict loss,logits,numeric_z or ranking_logits,prompt_hidden
model_API.single_sequence_controls: No registered target/relation modules or dead optimizer parameters; both arms P/C only26slots128float32=13312logicalbytes. M0 independent H30/H30 projections + nonzero static router; M3 H15/H30 + prompt router.
model_API.ranking_head: trainable query and shared frozen-description projection to128, L2-normalized dot scores with fixed temperature0.1;31 descriptions used semantically, not a31-ID classifier
model_API.ESM_baseline: both ESM layers and identical conditions; trainable FP32 MLP; no online Qwen. ELM gets same offline frozen description vectors. Report actual parameter/FLOP differences; M0=M3 matched within backbone/task only.
model_API.train_boundary: freeze ESM/Qwen; adapter/head float32, frozen Qwen bfloat16/eval; preserve gradient through frozen LM; answer-before outputs cannot depend on future gold tokens

training_API.CLI: python -m src.mt_train --config FILE --task TASK --method ESM|M0|M3 --backbone NAME --seed N --data-root DIR --cache-root DIR --output NEW --phase train-canary|formal [--max-updates4] --device cpu|cuda:0
training_API.config: top-level model,training,backbones,task_protocols,numerical_policy; config paths explicit absolute runtime paths
training_API.common_start: epochs5 provisional until actual TRAIN canaries; effective4; micro1/accum4; AdamW lr0.0003 wd0.01 clip1
training_API.regression: TRAIN-only zscore; head MSE plus LM answer-token CE for connectors; ESM head MSE. Original-valued test gold never rounded/clipped; supervised JSON value rounded4 decimals only.
training_API.elm: known-positive softmax ranking loss over shared31 candidate descriptions plus LM positive-description JSON CE for connectors; ranking-only for ESM. Unknown candidates are relative ranking alternatives, not experimental negative observations.
training_API.checkpoint: meltome max full-validation readout Spearman; elm max full-validation class-macro readout MRR; rt min full-selection525 readout MAE. Earliest exact tie; identical within each task across arms.
training_API.generation: separate LM channel, greedy; regression24 tokens; ELM256 tokens; strict one-field JSON melting_temperature_c|retention_time_min|function; no parse repair or numerical backfill
training_API.C1: same selected checkpoint readout on/off full test; report branch dependence only
training_API.output: run_manifest.json, training_history.json, progress.jsonl, checkpoint.pt (trainable CPU tensors only), selection.json, model_frozen_before_test.json, readout_predictions.jsonl, LM_predictions.jsonl (connector only), C1_predictions.jsonl, metrics.json, resource peaks and code/data/config/model/cache pins
training_API.canary: TRAIN only4updates16examples; no validation/test reads, TRAIN prefix scoring optional; no use of canary accuracy to freeze budget

metrics_API.prediction_rows: sample_id,prediction for regression; sample_id,ranking for ranking; sample_id,text for LM. Optional candidate_scores retained as evidence. Strict exact test ID coverage, duplicate/extra IDs rejected; missing/nonfinite accounted in coverage and whole-population aggregate null.
metrics_API.ranking: complete31-candidate unique ranking required; average-known-positive MRR/sample and class macro; stable candidate catalog tie order
metrics_API.RT_interval: calibration group-max absolute residual finite-sample quantile; empirical same-condition coverage and width only
metrics_API.analysis: all45 statuses including failed/unstarted; paired ESM-M0/M3 and M0-M3 by task/backbone/seed; mean/SD only complete3/3. Bootstrap uses fixed trained predictions and proper observed groups, not seed repeats as biological replicates.

runtime_API.behavior: one bounded owned worker per selected GPU plus one CPU ESM lane; gates only actual memory/storage/identity/pins; waits without app automation; exact owned PGID supervision+independent deadline watchdog; records and preserves every attempt/status; no use of old V4 supervisor hardcoded deadline
runtime_API.finalization: all cases terminal -> independent CPU rescoring and report; results synchronization uses one task-linked completion process, no recurring app monitor

ownership: Original V4 and foundation files immutable; all implementation lives in this new scope. Module owners coordinate API changes through parent.
